alt.en: The week view for 5 to 11 December 2026, one block per park day on an hour axis, with "Disney day 1 of 4" to "Disney day 4 of 4" and "Universal day 1 of 3" above the columns.

caption.en: Wednesday stays free: after three park days in a row, the plan puts the rest day on one of the busiest days of the trip.
